description: klc plugin hooks — one prompt hook that never blocks, plus the git-write guard; no MCP server

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; p=r'${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git_guard.py'; sys.exit(0) if not os.path.exists(p) else runpy.run_path(p, run_name='__main__')"
python3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; p=r'${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/klc.py'; sys.exit(0) if not os.path.exists(p) else runpy.run_path(p, run_name='__main__')"
